mixtral:8x7b.explanation: A seminal work on socially responsible design by Victor Papanek.

mixtral:8x7b.title: The Green Imperative: Ecology and Ethics in Design and Architecture

mixtral:8x7b.explanation: A humorous, insightful analysis by Victor Papanek on design failures.

gemma2:9b.title: Design for the Real World: Human Ecology and Social Change
gemma2:9b.explanation: In this influential work on design, Victor Papanek advocates for socially responsible and sustainable practices, emphasizing the importance of human ecology in the design process. The book challenges designers to consider the broader social implications of their work and to prioritize the needs of society over aesthetics.

gemma2:9b.title: The Green Imperative: Product Design for a Sustainable Future
gemma2:9b.explanation: Focuses on environmentally conscious design practices.
